description: Google Ads API Developer Assistant: config sync and session context (SessionStart), HITL mutation guard, protected-file write/credential-read guards, and MCP mutation checks (PreToolUse), and EXECUTE_FAILED audit logging for failed run_mutation.py --execute calls (PostToolUseFailure). Antigravity uses ../hooks.json instead.

hooks.command: S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/config/hook_guard.py"; if [ ! -f "$S" ]; then echo "Google Ads API Developer Assistant: hook_guard.py not found under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; reinstall the plugin. The HITL mutation guard cannot run." >&2; exit 2; fi; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$S" --cli claude --event SessionStart; fi; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "$S" --cli claude --event SessionStart; fi; if command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "$S" --cli claude --event SessionStart; fi; echo "Google Ads API Developer Assistant: Python 3 was not found on PATH (tried python3, python, py -3). The HITL mutation guard cannot run." >&2; exit 2
